verdict.rationale: Lovable documents connecting custom MCP servers so it can use them as live context while building. Admins can curate MCP registries so members connect servers as chat connectors in a couple of clicks, and the desktop app adds local MCP server support. The server-side MCP items (docs-8, docs-37) are a different role and are not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation of invoking action-taking tools beyond reading context.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Lovable can read from it as live context while you build: internal CRMs, private APIs, company knowledge bases, or niche third-party tools.
members then pick servers from it and connect them as chat connectors in a couple of clicks, instead of finding and pasting each server's URL by hand
You get everything in the web app plus local MCP server support
